card.name: Modifiers before infection and risk terms
card.fires_on: Short modifier or linking words that sit just before a clinical risk or condition noun, mostly in warnings about infection, immunosuppression or complications. Examples are active, acute, low, impair, increase and reduce.

modes.label: Adjective before condition
modes.description: An adjective such as active, acute or low that leads into a condition term.

modes.label: Verb before effect
modes.description: A verb such as impair, reduce or increase that begins a statement of effect on immunity or infection risk.
modes.example: Mercaptopurine is immunosuppressive and may<< impair>> the immune response to infectious agents or vaccines

card.plain: It marks small descriptive words that come right before an infection or risk term in warning sections.
